# Hillsborough {.unnumbered}

Download zipped file [here](https://github.com/tbep-tech/tbcmp-habitat/raw/refs/heads/main/data/05_habitat_class_update/oppmap_wgt_shp.zip).

```{r}
#| include: false
library(leaflet)
library(here)
library(sf)

i_am("docs/oppwgt_hillsborough.qmd")

source(here("R", "funcs.R"))

load(file = here('data', '01_inputs', 'tbcmp_cnt.RData'))
load(
  file = here('data', '05_habitat_class_update', 'oppmap_wgt_hillsborough.RData')
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
wgtmap_leaflet(oppmap_wgt_hillsborough, 'Hillsborough', tbcmp_cnt, simplify = 10)
```
Note: polygons have been simplified for web display.
